what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Hong Kong SAR, China in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 411 asylum seekers from Hong Kong SAR, China, and Australia hosted 70.3% of them.
After Australia, the largest hosts are Canada, the United Kingdom and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Hong Kong SAR, China, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 8 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 985, at the end of 2022, and was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
